text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno, Ikunooo~~! Turbo is in big trouble! 
My weight turned into a heavy vehicle!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What do I do?!! At this rate, my Turbo 
Engine's power is gonna drop!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then we should cut back on fats 
and add dietary fiber. I recommend burdock 
root, among other things.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!! No, no! Burdock is brown and 
borin—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! The cake on TV is the same color as 
Turbo! Turbo cake!? I wanna eat it, I 
wanna eat it!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, right after I said that... 
However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If its appearance can draw their interest, 
then before dinner, I'll do this and that 
to it...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo, how about this stir-fried 
vegetables and vegetable soup for dinner?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Everything's pink! It's like a 
festival!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I got some food coloring and dyed it. This 
is a special meal just for you, Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Food coloring...?? I don't really get it, 
but Ikuno, you're amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I consulted Ikuno! Turbo is a 
genius!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. As your friend, I'm honored to hear 
that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Twin Turbo kept up her 
healthy diet this way, and her weight-loss 
plan was a success.
